page_title: LIV 5-2 WHU | Liverpool v West Ham 28/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+6' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
90+6' A pass into the penalty area from Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is intercepted by the defence.
90+5' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
90+2' Close! Trey Nyoni (Liverpool) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Substitution. El Hadji Malick Diouf did his best and is replaced by Ezra Mayers (West Ham).
90' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to make a change. Mohamadou Kante (West Ham) replaces Tomas Soucek.
87' Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Mads Hermansen.
86' Substitution. Ryan Gravenberch walks off the pitch and Trey Nyoni (Liverpool) comes on as a substitute.
85' The foul by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Tim Robinson.
82' 5 - 2 What bad luck! Axel Disasi (West Ham) got in the way of a pass and unintentionally sent the ball past his own goalkeeper. The score is 5:2.
82' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.

81' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
79' Tim Robinson shows a yellow card to Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) for his blatant foul.
78' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
77' Arne Slot has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) replacing Joe Gomez.
76' The referee allows time for a substitution. Hugo Ekitike will be replaced by Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool).
76' Substitution. Soungoutou Magassa is replaced by Adama Traore (West Ham).
75' 4 - 2 Taty Castellanos (West Ham) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header into the roof of the net from close range. The score is 4:2.
75' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) will take the corner.
75' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the top of the net is smartly dealt with by Alisson. It will be a corner kick for West Ham.
72' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) makes a rough challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.
70' 4 - 1 Goal! Hugo Ekitike plays it to Cody Gakpo (Liverpool), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Mads Hermansen. 4:1.
70' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
69' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Liverpool.
66' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards over the bar.

65' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Alisson!
63' A dangerous looking corner kick from Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) is cleared to safety by the defence.
61' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
59' Tim Robinson blows his whistle after Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
55' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Tim Robinson ignores the protests.
54' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His effort goes inches wide of the left post.
52' Tim Robinson blows his whistle. Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) commits a foul after dangerous play.
50' The West Ham players halt their celebrations as referee Tim Robinson makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
49' 3 - 1 Goal! El Hadji Malick Diouf passes the ball to the feet of Tomas Soucek (West Ham), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 3:1.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

45' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Tim Robinson shows a yellow card to Soungoutou Magassa (West Ham), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

43' 3 - 0 It's a goal! Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the top left corner. The assist goes to Hugo Ekitike and the score changes to 3:0.
43' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Liverpool.

43' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort. Now Liverpool have a corner.

40' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) meets a brilliant cross on the edge of the box and fires the ball towards the middle of the goal, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and blocks the effort.
38' Half-chance! Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) plays a pass into the box, but Alisson reacts well to snuff out the attack.
38' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
37' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.

36' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
35' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Crysencio Summerville (West Ham).
33' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
31' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
31' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Alisson.
29' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Tim Robinson blows for a foul.
26' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) commits a rough challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for an infringement.

24' 2 - 0 Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the right side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 2:0.
24' There's an opportunity for Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
24' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Liverpool.

23' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.

20' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom right corner. Mads Hermansen has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
15' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
15' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner.
12' Tim Robinson blows for a foul after Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
12' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
12' West Ham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
12' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) leaps highest to meet the resulting corner and attempts to head home, but the effort goes harmlessly wide of the left post.
11' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) will take a corner kick.
7' Tim Robinson couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Joe Gomez (Liverpool) and blew his whistle.
5' 1 - 0 Goal! Ryan Gravenberch plays it to Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Mads Hermansen. 1:0.
5' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
5' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Corner kick. Liverpool will have an opportunity.
3' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a clever chip pass, but one of the defending players comes up with a timely interception.
1' The players are out at last! Liverpool will take the kick-off.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Tim Robinson is introduced as the referee for today's match.
